title: indexable/_make_indexable must return dataframes in their native type, never wrapped in narwhals
answers: cross_val_score passes narwhals DataFrame to my estimator
estimator receives wrong dataframe type in cross_val_predict / permutation_test_score
does indexable convert pandas/polars to narwhals?
why does my custom estimator get nw.DataFrame instead of pandas
body:
Symptom: in CV tools (cross_val_predict, cross_val_score, permutation_test_score), user estimators received narwhals DataFrame/Series wrappers instead of the pandas/polars/pyarrow objects they were given.
Root cause: sklearn/utils/validation.py:_make_indexable returned `nw.from_native(iterable, allow_series=True)` for dataframe-like inputs (regression from #33959). indexable() is used by model_selection to prepare X/y, which then flow unchanged into estimator.fit/predict.
Fix pattern: return the native object as-is (`return iterable`). Narwhals may be used internally for checking or indexing, but anything indexable returns must keep the caller's type.
Constraints: input type = output type for all containers. The one intended exception is sparse: non-CSR sparse is converted to CSR (csc_array -> csr_array). Lists, tuples, arrays, pandas Index/Series, polars Series and pyarrow arrays come back unchanged. This is enforced by sklearn/utils/tests/test_validation.py:test_indexable_return_type. Do not loosen sklearn/model_selection/tests/test_validation.py:test_cross_val_and_permutation_test_on_dataframe to accept `x.to_native()`. It must check the exact native type.
applies: Any change to sklearn.utils.indexable/_make_indexable or the dataframe handling of CV/model_selection utilities
